comparison.objective: Attach edging blocks to two lenses at specified optical offsets.
comparison.physical_skill: Lens registration and adhesive/block placement, not stabilized mandrel hammering or loose-metal recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both blocks are 8 mm temporal of optical center; attachment tolerances and damage rubric are unavailable because no spec version is provided.
comparison.reason: Precision placement is shared generically, but the tested operation lacks impact fracture, retained-coil protection, and fragment containment.
